note: Summers County-run primitive camping area on Bluestone Lake's east shore at the end of County Route 3/3, south of Hinton, inside Bluestone Wildlife Management Area. Sites strung along the shoreline in dirt clearings; fire rings, some tables. CAVEATS: nobody has reported what size rig fits - sites are dirt pads reached by gravel county roads, so scout before bringing EKKO in; the area floods in high water and parts may flood more often during the ongoing Bluestone Dam work (DNR District 4, 304-256-6947, has gate-closure updates). --Claude  AWH 2026-10-11: kept, though we can't tell whether the sites suit RVs. Call (304) 466-7119 for info. --Claude
summary: Summers County's Parks & Rec page still names Bertha among its four primitive Bluestone WMA campgrounds, $15/night/site (fees already manual, re-confirmed), and gives the season: changed season year_round:false -> May-November (water levels permitting). Neither the county page nor DNR's District 4 WMA page says anything about a closure of Bertha for the Bluestone Dam work (unlike the state park's Old Mill and East Shore). Not stated: site count, facilities, booking (left derived). Note trimmed of the count/price/season/facility restatements.
flags: Conflicting DNR page: WV DNR's District 4 WMA page says under '51. Bluestone Lake' 'On the WMA: Camping is not permitted', while Summers County lists Bertha as a $15 primitive campground on the WMA (same conflict as Cedar Branch 14062 and Shanklin Ferry 14063).

No closure found: no county, DNR or other official page mentions Bertha being closed for the Bluestone Dam construction; the only dam caveat is the long-standing warning that WMA areas may flood more often. DNR District 4 (304-256-6947) has gate-closure updates.
Criteria (already accepted by AWH 2026-10-11): no official page says whether a 23-ft motorhome fits; the county says only 'primitive camping only'.
